decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX builds on the established BASIC 518 trommel, a core mobile screening product with proven customer acceptance, so it is likely to stay even though the website did not show it in 2020 to 2021.
Mobile high-speed flail shredders fit the firm's core mobile recycling portfolio and serve its waste and biomass customers, despite some uncertainty from the missing website presence after 2019.
The green-waste grinder serves established composting customers, but the earlier withdrawal of the similar high-speed grinder line C suggests this segment is under review, which raises the risk.

Stationary single-shaft pre-shredders support the firm's plant-based and international strategy, though stationary lines are more exposed to portfolio streamlining, as the withdrawal of Product D showed.
